response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and systems experience, there is minimal evidence of deep JVM, Java/Kotlin, or enterprise framework (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus) expertise — critical for this role. His work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only passing Java mentions in old roles without context on IDE tooling or JVM internals.
strengths: Proven track record in building complex developer tooling and open-source projects
Strong background in cross-platform systems and performance-critical applications
Active contributor to developer education through workshops and talks
concerns: No demonstrable experience with Spring, Hibernate, or other enterprise Java frameworks
Lack of visible contribution to IDEs, language servers, or JVM tooling internals
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, not Java/Kotlin
